title: 8x8 Procedural Images: Four Bar Positions (Residual-Upsample Width-16)
intuition: Architectural transfer variant of `img_bars4` replacing transposed convolutions with nearest-neighbor upsampling + width-16 residual Conv2d blocks. Four discrete spatial bar locations (two vertical, two horizontal) on 8x8 grayscale images. Exposes cross-valley barycentric mode collapse on convolutional generators when batch/particle coupling is soft.
failure_mode: Historically a major discriminator: BCAP, BISPF, EMPF-v8, and RHBI-v12 collapsed to 2/4 bars or blurry superpositions.
protocol_notes: Separate residual-upsample image architecture cohort of `img_bars4`.
